canonical_project: Gangwon East Coast 1GW Data Center Hub near Gangneung and Donghae
notes: Government and Gangwon provincial sources were reported as considering a 1 GW cluster near Gangneung and Donghae, potentially up to 50 data centers averaging 20 MW each. This appears to be an area-level plan and may overlap with later Gangneung/Donghae project announcements.
